summary: 竖屏直播支持拖动拼组，每组最多3路，同屏最多20路！新增4路独立录制，支持结束后自动合并和异常通知；配置导入导出现已包含软件设置、监控方案与布局。同时新增斗鱼弹幕等级过滤、发送颜色选择，完善启动登录恢复、播放线路恢复及小窗操作体验。
summaryEn: Group up to 3 portrait streams and watch up to 20 streams. Record up to 4 streams with optional merging and failure alerts. Transfer settings and layouts, filter Douyu chat by level, choose chat colors, and enjoy improved sign-in recovery, stream recovery and compact controls.
